summary:
Satellite Farm is a precision agriculture web platform built on Next.js that democratizes access to open NASA Earth observation data to help small and medium-sized farmers make evidence-based decisions, without the need for expensive sensors or advanced technical knowledge.

Based on the coordinates and characteristics of each plot, the system monitors soil moisture (SMAP), plant stress/NDVI (MODIS), climate (GPM/MERRA-2) and the local ecological environment in real time. Depending on the grower's goals (restore soil, maximize profits, save water or improve irrigation), an automated engine recommends the optimal crop rotation plan for the following season supported by comparative weather charts. In addition, it integrates a voice and text artificial intelligence assistant (openai/gpt-oss-120b) contextualized with real agricultural metrics, along with an interactive 3D globe and a community forum where local and international farmers share experiences and request collaborative reviews of their crops.
details: Satellite Farm is a web-based precision agriculture platform that turns complex NASA Earth observation data into clear, actionable farming decisions. Without needing expensive field sensors or GIS expertise, farmers can register their plots and immediately access real-time satellite telemetry—including soil moisture (SMAP), vegetative stress/NDVI (MODIS), and climate patterns (GPM/MERRA-2)—alongside local biodiversity context (fauna, flora, and nearby agglomerations). Based on the farmer’s seasonal goal (restoring soil, maximizing profits, saving water, or improving irrigation), an automated decision engine recommends an optimal crop rotation plan (Plan A, B, or C) backed by comparative monthly climate charts. Additionally, an integrated voice-enabled AI assistant (openai/gpt-oss-120b) answers spoken or written questions using live farm metrics, while an interactive 3D global map lets producers share local updates, read international experiences, and request peer reviews from other farms. Benefits & Intended ImpactBy removing hardware barriers and offering hands-free voice interaction with multilingual support, Satellite Farm makes space science practical for small and medium-scale producers working directly in the field. Its intended impact is threefold: Environmental Sustainability: Reduces water waste and reverses soil degradation through scientifically matched crop rotations. Climate Resilience: Helps farmers anticipate droughts and heat stress via early satellite alerts and tailored AI advice. Global Collaboration: Connects isolated growers to a worldwide knowledge network so successful agricultural practices can be replicated across similar climate zones. Tools, Tech Stack & Creative ApproachBuilt on Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, React, and HTML5/CSS3/JS, the application connects NASA Earthdata/POWER APIs and the openai/gpt-oss-120b model through validated, rate-limited API routes (/api/chat and /api/farm) supported by automated .mjs test suites on standard development hardware. What makes the project especially creative is its dual fusion of multimodal AI with live orbital telemetry—allowing farmers to simply talk to their satellite data—and a multi-AI development workflow where NotebookLM curated NASA datasets, Figma Make prototyped the UX, Claude built the initial 3D globe frontend, ChatGPT migrated the codebase to Next.js, and Gemini structured the documentation and pitch. Key Factors Considered by the TeamRural Connectivity & Reliability: Implemented input validation, rate limiting, lightweight payloads, and dedicated smoke/mock tests so the platform stays fast and stable even under weak internet or API interruptions. Actionability Over Raw Data: Translated complex scientific indices into simple seasonal pathways and plain-language voice guidance rather than overwhelming farmers with raw spreadsheets. Accessibility: Designed a responsive, multilingual interface with voice chat to eliminate technical and language barriers.
